brand.name: Mowgli Games
brand.tagline: Soft, round, and a little silly.

sentence.en: Mowgli Games is an independent studio making soft, playful casual games that anyone can pick up and enjoy.
sentence.ko: 모글리 게임즈는 누구나 쉽게 시작하고 즐길 수 있는, 말랑하고 장난스러운 캐주얼 게임을 만드는 인디 스튜디오입니다.

set.name: Bounce
set.mechanism: Squash and stretch, the animation rule that makes things feel soft: a ball drawn in two frames (stretched, then squashed) is the mark, a tall stretched rounded face sets the type, and big yellow fields carry the near-black ink.
set.expression_move: Whole yellow surfaces; the mark and type stay single-colour ink on top.
set.differs_by: The loud route: yellow is the ground here, not the highlight, with dark kept for ink and imagery.

logo.concept: One ball in two frames: stretched in the air, squashed on landing. Also reads as a soft exclamation mark.

rationale.claim: Dark imagery with a deep yellow key colour is the user's stated preference; this route flips the proportions.
Squash and stretch is a core animation principle for soft, elastic motion, and gives the mark a built-in idle animation.
rationale.source: Thomas & Johnston, The Illusion of Life (1981)

rationale.claim: Yellow is vivid only when light and needs a dark partner, so ink is near-black.
